decisions.reason: F5 cites the ODE supplier for joint continuity under spatial-Lipschitz and origin-growth bounds alone, omitting joint continuity of the drift. For b(t,x,y)=1_{y>=0} on [0,1], L_K=0 and a_K=1 satisfy those bounds, but T(x,y)=(x+1_{y>=0},y) is discontinuous at y=0. This is a false cited fact, not merely an omitted routine proof step. The Statement and proof 2.1 already require all ODE hypotheses. Repaired F5 to state joint continuity, the simultaneous almost-everywhere uniform bounds, and the AC consequences; no claim was weakened.

reviews.reason: The repaired F5 states joint continuity and the simultaneous compact-parameter-uniform integrable bounds required by the ODE supplier; AC supplies DC and CC. Finite second moments justify coordinatewise L2 projection, and standard-Borel disintegration followed by zero-filled coordinate integrals supplies the measurable representative. Linearity proves unbiased loss only for fixed candidates. The jointly continuous triangular flow is Borel with bijective fibers; the separate exact joint pushforward identity gives the posterior outside one common marginal-null set. The original Statement and both proof steps are unchanged from the assigned carrier.
